about_the_game:
Humanity's last chance.

Join the Legion and fight for freedom against a tyrant in a galaxy far, far away in this fierce, frantic, treacherous and fast-paced third/first-person shooter.

BECOME A HERO

You'll join a squad of up to five Warriors who must exterminate the followers of the tyrant Nihilus with a bomb or through teamwork. Take care of your allies, betrayal and friendly fire are a sad fact of this crusade, but it's impossible to win without working as a team.


STORY MODE - HUMANITY'S LAST CHANCE

Resistance. Betrayal. Hope.

This is the Legion's war against the tyrant Nihilus.

In a devastated galaxy, humanity faces total collapse.

You are one of the warriors chosen to lead the rebellion against a force that has gone beyond human limits.

Nihilus dominates chaos and manipulates natural disasters to eradicate what remains of civilisation.

Experimente uma campanha intensa em que cada decisão pode salvar ou condenar o futuro.

Tupã, the conscious planet, is humanity's last refuge - a living ally trying to protect it from the forces of destruction.

But not even it can guarantee your survival.

The fate of the universe depends on you.

Lead. Fight. And save what's left.

MULTIPLAYER MODE - ENDLESS WAR

Competition. Strategy. Chaos.

Multiplayer mode is a dynamic war where each match evolves in phases, taking players from solo combat to coordinated team operations, culminating in the dreaded Oblivion Event.

Recon

The battle begins brutally.

Each player emerges alone, must loot weapons and survive on a hostile map.

With PvP mode active, survival is momentary: dying means starting over.

During this phase, players accumulate Experience (XP) based on performance - kills, survival and resources collected.

These points will define team formations in the next phase.

Main Strike

The forces are organised.

Teams of 4v4 or 5v5 face each other in tactical operations where one must plant the Oblivion device and the other must prevent its activation.

Each map is designed to encourage coordination, positioning and role specialisation.

Oblivion

Once the device is armed, everything changes.
The environment collapses, danger zones emerge, and the battlefield transforms in real time.
Cluster too close and the planet punishes you. Spread too far and your strength fades.
When the countdown ends, the Oblivion detonates, ending the round in a devastating explosion.

Purge

The post-war period begins.

Everyone is reborn alone in a free-for-all mode where only one survives.

Whoever achieves the most eliminations wins the final podium and the recognition of the Legion.

Each stage redefines the battlefield. Each victory comes at a price.

content_descriptors.notes: Frontline: New Revolution é um jogo de tiro em terceira pessoa baseado em equipes, onde você se alista à Legião para lutar pela liberdade contra um tirano numa galáxia distante. Equipado com uma variedade de armas e estratégias, como pistolas, metralhadoras e ataques aéreos, enfrente inimigos ferozes em batalhas intensas. Prepare-se para um combate brutal com sangue, desmembramentos e explosões devastadoras enquanto luta para aniquilar as forças opressoras e garantir a vitória.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10, 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core I3-10100F
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1080
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10, 32-64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
